title: VPN Connection Failure — Cisco AnyConnect
error_codes: Error: Connection attempt has timed out
Error: The VPN client was unable to setup IP filtering
Error: Reconnecting to the secure gateway
Error: Unable to establish a connection
prerequisites: Corporate laptop with Cisco AnyConnect installed
diagnostic_questions: Are you on a corporate or personal network?
Can you access any websites (e.g., google.com)?
Is this the first time you're connecting from this location?
When did the VPN last work successfully?

diagnostic_tools.purpose: Verify the VPN gateway is operational

resolution_steps.action: Close Cisco AnyConnect completely. Right-click the AnyConnect icon in the system tray and select 'Quit'.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Is AnyConnect fully closed? (No icon in system tray)

resolution_steps.action: Open a web browser and verify you can reach google.com. This confirms basic internet connectivity.
Relaunch Cisco AnyConnect and enter the VPN server address: vpn.corporate.com. Click 'Connect'.
Enter your corporate credentials (same as email login) and complete MFA if prompted.
Clear the DNS cache to resolve stale DNS entries. Open Command Prompt as Administrator and run: ipconfig /flushdns
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did you see 'Successfully flushed the DNS Resolver Cache'?

resolution_steps.action: Your internet connection appears to be down. Try the following: 1) Disconnect and reconnect to Wi-Fi, 2) Try using a mobile hotspot, 3) Restart your router if on home network.

escalation_criteria: If all steps fail after 2 attempts, or if the VPN gateway is confirmed down
